description: Interior of a large basilica-like hall with a barrel-vaulted, coffered ceiling and gilded details. Rows of bishops in white mitres and white-and-red vestments fill the foreground and sides, many with raised hands. At the far end, a figure in white sits on a throne on a raised dais with a red carpet, flanked by candles and a canopy. Lightning flashes through tall arched windows on the right under a dark storm sky. The image fills the frame edge to edge with no border.
